name: max-circle
description: Raise existing documentation to the English register of Circle's developer docs — plain claim before the term, single-arc sentences, in-sentence benefits, paired-verb mechanisms, action + "without" instead of negation, You/Us responsibility splits. A register pass that preserves every fact, link, and caveat. Built on the plain-prose canon (classic style, Williams, Google & Microsoft style guides) and a three-tier system mined from the Circle corpus: six sentence habits, per-mode section choreography (guide contracts, step openers, outcome confirmations), and the Circle lexicon — with a verbatim pattern library shipped alongside.
